import sys

class Counter:
    def __init__(self):
        self.zone = "OUTSIDE"
        self.wordStart = True
        self.curOut = 0
        self.maxOut = 0
        self.insideWords = 0

    def add(self, c):
        if c == '(':
            self.zone = "INSIDE"
            self.wordStart = True
            self.curOut = 0
        elif c == ')':
            self.zone = "OUTSIDE"
            self.curOut = 0
        elif self.zone == "OUTSIDE":
            if c == '_':
                self.curOut = 0
            else:
                self.curOut += 1
                if self.curOut > self.maxOut:
                    self.maxOut = self.curOut
        else:  # INSIDE
            if c == '_':
                self.wordStart = True
            elif self.wordStart:
                self.insideWords += 1
                self.wordStart = False

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    while True:
        try:
            n = int(next(it))
            s = next(it)
        except StopIteration:
            break
        counter = Counter()
        for ch in s[:n]:
            counter.add(ch)
        print(counter.maxOut, counter.insideWords)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
